description: Reads ONE subnet: name, typeIdentifier, netType, every readable attribute, `updatable` (the attribute names tia_subnet_update can change on it, plus Name when it is writable), the connected `nodes` [{device, interface, node, address, subnetMask}] and the `ioSystems` [{name, number, controller, devices}] on it. Read it before tia_subnet_update or tia_subnet_delete: the nodes and IO systems listed are what a delete would disconnect or remove. An unknown subnet is 404 not_found. Requires a connected project. `inventoryGaps` [{kind, subject, reason}] lists every read that failed while the serve scanned the project (empty when all succeeded); a non-empty list means the nodes and IO systems above may be incomplete. A gap of kind `io_system_subnet` also carries `ioSystem` {number, controller}, the identity the serve decides on (`subject` is only the name). A `subnet_attribute` gap with the subject `<subnet> attribute list` means the attribute LIST could not be read: `updatable: []` is then a gap, not a statement that nothing is writable. A `subnet_attribute` gap with the subject `<subnet>.<attribute>` is one attribute that could not be read (it is absent from `attributes`) and says nothing about `updatable`. Maps to GET /subnets/{subnet}. Read-only (class R).

subnet.description: subnet name, as listed by tia_subnets
